--- title: "Illustrations" subtitle: "Maps, colours, and areas of the MEASO regions" --- All figures on this page are made in R from the published files and the package data sets; expand "Code" to see how. ## Colours The colours of the MEASO Summary for Policymakers (Figure 5); see [Definition](definition.qmd#colours). ::: {#tbl-colours .cell tbl-cap='Fill colours by sector and zone (version 06). T regions have no colour.'} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true" code-summary="Code"} colour_table <- function(x) { cell <- function(name, fill) { if (is.na(fill)) return(sprintf("%s", name)) rgb <- col2rgb(fill) fg <- if (sum(rgb * c(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)) > 140) "black" else "white" sprintf('%s
%s', substr(fill, 1, 7), fg, name, fg, substr(fill, 1, 7)) } zones <- c("Antarctic", "Subantarctic", "Northern", NA) rows <- vapply(unique(x$sector), function(s) { d <- x[x$sector == s, ] cells <- vapply(zones, function(z) { i <- which(if (is.na(z)) is.na(d$zone) else d$zone %in% z) cell(d$name[i], d$fill[i]) }, "") sprintf("%s%s", s, paste(cells, collapse = "")) }, "") cat('', "", rows, "
AntarcticSubantarcticNorthern(outside)
", sep = "\n") } colour_table(x) ```

::: ### Version 05 colours The colours of version 05 (`measo_names` in the R package), as released. Sectors that alternate around the continent share a palette. The first of the two West Pacific Antarctic (WPA) rows in `measo_names` has a different colour (an error); this table shows the second. ::: {#tbl-colours-05 .cell tbl-cap='Fill colours by sector and zone (version 05).'} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true" code-summary="Code"} colour_table(measo_names[!duplicated(measo_names$name, fromLast = TRUE), ]) ```

::: ## Polar map ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true" code-summary="Code"} cst <- measo_regions06_coastline par(mar = rep(0, 4)) plot(st_union(st_geometry(x)), col = "grey80", border = NA) ## continent shows through plot(st_geometry(cst), col = cst$fill, border = "grey60", lwd = 0.3, add = TRUE) pos <- st_coordinates(suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(x)))) text(pos, x$name, cex = 0.7) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![MEASO regions in the polar equal area projection, with the continent cut out.](illustrations_files/figure-html/fig-polar-1.png){#fig-polar width=672} ::: ::: ## Longitude/latitude map ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true" code-summary="Code"} ll <- measo_regions06_ll_coastline par(mar = c(2.5, 2.5, 0.5, 0.5)) plot(st_geometry(ll), col = ifelse(is.na(ll$fill), "grey97", ll$fill), border = "grey50", axes = TRUE, xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-85, -30)) ## label positions from the polar centroids cds <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_centroid(st_geometry(measo_regions06)), 4326)) text(cds, measo_regions06$name, cex = 0.55) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![MEASO regions in longitude/latitude. The West Pacific regions are in two parts, either side of the anti-meridian.](illustrations_files/figure-html/fig-ll-1.png){#fig-ll width=672} ::: ::: ## Sectors and zones ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true" code-summary="Code"} op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = rep(0.2, 4)) ## each sector's hue (its Northern zone colour) sec_col <- with(x[x$zone %in% "Northern", ], setNames(fill, sector)) plot(st_geometry(x), col = sec_col[x$sector], border = "white") legend("bottomleft", legend = names(sec_col), fill = sec_col, bty = "n", cex = 0.7) zone_col <- c(Antarctic = "#BEE7FA", Subantarctic = "#0E94AF", Northern = "#0A4F70") plot(st_geometry(x), col = ifelse(is.na(x$zone), "grey95", zone_col[x$zone]), border = "white") legend("bottomleft", legend = c(names(zone_col), "outside MEASO"), fill = c(zone_col, "grey95"), bty = "n", cex = 0.7) par(op) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Sectors (left, in their hues from Figure 5) and zones (right, in the zone colours of Figure 7) of the MEASO Summary for Policymakers.](illustrations_files/figure-html/fig-sector-zone-1.png){#fig-sector-zone width=864} ::: ::: ## Areas Areas are calculated in the polar equal area projection, for the full regions and with the continent cut out. ::: {#tbl-areas .cell tbl-cap='Region areas (million km²).'} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true" code-summary="Code"} tab <- data.frame(name = measo_regions06$name, label = measo_regions06$label, full = round(as.numeric(st_area(measo_regions06)) / 1e12, 2), without_continent = round(as.numeric(st_area(measo_regions06_coastline)) / 1e12, 2)) knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |name |label | full| without_continent| |:----|:---------------------------|-----:|-----------------:| |AOA |Antarctic Atlantic | 12.11| 9.89| |AOS |Subantarctic Atlantic | 4.49| 4.49| |AON |Northern Atlantic | 4.63| 4.63| |AOT |Temperate Atlantic | 11.74| 11.74| |CIA |Antarctic Central Indian | 8.02| 3.76| |CIS |Subantarctic Central Indian | 8.12| 8.12| |CIN |Northern Central Indian | 3.90| 3.90| |CIT |Temperate Central Indian | 9.94| 9.94| |EIA |Antarctic East Indian | 4.05| 1.69| |EIS |Subantarctic East Indian | 3.70| 3.70| |EIN |Northern East Indian | 3.62| 3.62| |EIT |Temperate East Indian | 7.69| 7.69| |WPA |Antarctic West Pacific | 5.63| 4.91| |WPS |Subantarctic West Pacific | 2.84| 2.84| |WPN |Northern West Pacific | 7.28| 7.28| |WPT |Temperate West Pacific | 7.50| 7.50| |EPA |Antarctic East Pacific | 3.56| 2.19| |EPS |Subantarctic East Pacific | 3.28| 3.28| |EPN |Northern East Pacific | 6.26| 6.26| |EPT |Temperate East Pacific | 8.60| 8.60| ::: ::: ## Plots on a map The regions make a natural layout for small plots of data summarised by region. The [map-patches](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/blob/main/vignettes/map-patches.Rmd) vignette in the R package shows one way to do this with ggplot2 and patchwork.
